stories.headline: Nvidia hits all-time record worth $5.7 trillion
AI is now acing accounting exams
AI drew a world map from 16,200 GPS questions
US-bound oil tanker had its propulsion system hacked
One prompt and music, Opus 5.5 finished a project overnight

caption:
Here's what happened in AI in the last 24 hours, from Nvidia hitting a $5.7 trillion all-time high to AI passing accounting exams

Nvidia broke its all-time stock record. The company is now worth $5.7 trillion, the highest any chipmaker has ever been. $10,000 invested ten years ago is $1.58 million today.

AI passed accounting exams, the same tests your accountant spent years studying for.

Researchers asked an AI "land or water?" 16,200 times using GPS coordinates, then plotted the answers as an image. It drew an accurate map of Earth. It never studied geography, it just read the internet.

A US-bound oil tanker had its propulsion system hacked mid-voyage.

Four stories, one day. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.
